interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to listen on (e.g., ['eth0', 'ens160']). Leave empty to skip auto-detection and use runtime flag `-i`.

port.description: UDP port to listen for NetFlow v5/v9, IPFIX, or sFlow data.

tcp_port.description: TCP port to listen for sFlow over TCP. Set to 0 to disable.

base_dir.description: Root directory where flow data files (nfcapd.* binaries) are stored. Subdirectories are auto-created by date.

archive_dir.description: Relative subdirectory under base_dir for archived/compressed rotated files. Leave blank to disable archiving.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain flow files before automatic deletion.

bpf_filter.description: Optional Berkeley Packet Filter expression (e.g., 'udp portrange 2055-2057') to reduce noise. Leave blank to accept all.

flush_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before flushing pending buffers to disk. Higher values reduce I/O but increase risk of data loss on crash.

rotate_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) for rotating flow files (e.g., 600 = 10 minutes).

compress.description: Whether to compress rotated files with gzip (yes/no or true/false).

format.description: Output format: 'standard' (default) or 'extended' (includes additional metadata such as router IP, if available).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for service management (e.g., systemd). Set to empty to disable.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after binding ports (security best practice).

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after binding ports.

daemonize.description: Whether to run nfcapd in background daemon mode (yes/no or true/false).

sflow_extended.description: Enable support for vendor-specific sFlow extensions (e.g., NetApp, Juniper).

template_cache.description: Enable NetFlow v9/IPFIX template caching (required for v9/IPFIX support).

mempool_size.description: Memory pool size (in MB) for packet buffering. Set >0 (e.g., 32) only if you observe dropped packets under high load.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors. Set >0 (e.g., 65535) only if system limit allows and you expect many files.

skip_stale.description: Skip flow records older than N seconds when reading from a pipe or reprocessing. Set >0 to avoid stale data ingestion.

extra_opts.description: Additional command-line options (e.g., '-z' for gzip compression, '-l' for logging level). Use sparingly — prefer above settings.
